moments.title: Why He's Changing Canadian VC
moments.insight: Nectar explains Amiral Ventures launched to fill a gap: Canada lacks VC capital and funds willing to lead rounds and write term sheets.

moments.title: The Brain Drain Problem
moments.insight: He argues Canada's best talent leaves because the US has the big generational tech companies, not because founders are wrong to go.

moments.title: French Wine vs. Canadian Wine
moments.insight: Using a wine analogy, he says Silicon Valley has generations of maturity while Canada's tech ecosystem is only at 'generation 1.5 or 2.'

moments.title: Canada's Innovation, Not Commercialization
moments.insight: He notes Canada birthed transformer AI and smartphone tech but has historically failed to commercialize its own breakthroughs.

moments.title: No One Knows What Will Work
moments.insight: He refuses to dismiss startup ideas, citing how top investors called Airbnb 'the dumbest idea' before it became a giant success.

moments.title: The Founder Trait That Matters Most
moments.insight: Nectar says a founder's skin color, age, or gender is irrelevant—what matters is the quality of their ideas and their grit under pressure.
